files.change_summary: Fixed BE SOC pad pairing and link-validation pipeline lookup.
CSI-2 link validation uses the matching pad/pipeline context.
New SP7 front-RGB route and bounded start-abort helper.
New helper separates link-validation context from pad ownership.

IR start verification and queue-lifecycle diagnostics. Failed-start rollback and bounded raw timestamp diagnostics. Pending-start buffer transaction and deferred sensor start. Bounded read-only clock-control and PCI identity diagnostics. Bounded SP7 front-RGB start verification and rollback.
Pending-start state and held-completion list declarations.
Independent BE SOC pad propagation and pipeline validation.

IR firmware-stop/lifecycle diagnostics. STOP policy for failed IR starts and last-buffer errors. Prepared-sensor ownership, queued start and unwind receipts. Bounded front-RGB rollback and independent pad-aware pipelines.
Separate last PIN_DATA_READY error state. Prepared-sensor state and queued-start declaration.
IR firmware acknowledgement diagnostics. Retain last PIN_DATA_READY error separately. Front-RGB firmware acknowledgement diagnostics.
Transient link-validation pipeline context and helper include.
